The smartphone UI screen is from an app called "Verse Explorer." The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **App Title and Navigation Bar**: At the top, there is a title bar with the app name "Verse Explorer." It also includes a menu icon on the left, a refresh icon, and a search icon on the right.

2. **Verse Display**: The main section of the screen displays a Bible verse. In this instance, it shows a verse from the Book of Luke, Chapter 24, Verse 18. The verse is quoted in the center of the screen.

3. **Verse Information**: Above the verse, there is a header indicating the book (Luke), chapter (24), and verse (18).
